cases.answer_excerpt:

* **ACIT 2515 (Object Oriented Programming):** Requires a minimum grade of 50% in ACIT 1515 (or 60% in COMP 1516).

* **ACIT 2520 (Developing Web Applications):** Requires a minimum grade of 50% in ACIT 1515 along with 50% in ACIT 1620.

cases.question: which course can I learn how to use terraform?
cases.standalone_question: Which BCIT course teaches how to use Terraform?
cases.answer_excerpt:
You can learn how to use Terraform in the course **ACIT 4640**, which includes dedicated topics on Terraform and Terraform HCL syntax starting around week 4. Additionally, **COMP 4964** (DevOps Engineering) covers Terraform and Ansible around week 12 of its schedule.

- ACIT 4640 covers Terraform fundamentals starting in week 4, including Terraform commands, variables, modules, and deploying images created with Packer.
- COMP 4964 covers Terraform and Ansible in week 12 to help students configure development, test, and production environments using automation tools.

Sources:
- https://www.bcit.ca/outlines/20253043982/
- https://www.bcit.ca/outlines/20261089230/
